units.task_features.csv: one independent task; eight profiles averaged within condition; 82 rows

important_semantics.page_N: the Nth exact content-bearing documentation-only tool output; one output may contain multiple documentation paths, recorded by page_N_path_count
important_semantics.wiki_tokens: sum of measured documentation-only output tokens; mixed or ambiguous outputs are excluded, so this is a conservative exposure measure
important_semantics.task_aggregation: profiles are repeated measurements and are averaged before task-level EDA
important_semantics.causal_boundary: page structure and task type are pre-treatment descriptors; delivered exposure and trajectory features are descriptive mechanisms, not randomized mediators
important_semantics.prediction_scoring: all valid raw ranked-file predictions are scored; adherence labels remain trajectory metadata and do not replace valid predictions with zeros
important_semantics.agent_step_count: one NativeToolAccess equals one agent tool-use step; a compound shell command with pipes, conjunctions, semicolons, or multiple subcommands remains one step
important_semantics.elapsed_seconds: sealed raw-run wall-clock duration from provider process start to finish

deliberately_excluded: fine-grained per-command timing beyond total cell duration
cell-level inference that treats profiles as independent tasks
protected gold paths or raw predictions in exported feature tables
